slide: 13 · The study – A Mediterranean case study

headline: Each site has its own robust precursors
bullets: 99 site–cluster pairs chosen by all 3 seeds, vs 72 expected by chance
Precursors are mostly local: sites share them only at chance level
Most shared: soil moisture north-east of the Black Sea (5 sites)

headline: Local warming precedes heatwaves by up to 3 weeks
bullets: Warm air over or next to the site, 3–20 days ahead
Confirmed in 2011–2021 at 7 of 12 sites
Strongest: Sardinia (+0.67σ) and Greece (+0.49σ)

headline: A nearby ridge precedes heatwaves by up to 2–3 weeks
bullets: Ridge over or next to the site, 3–17 days ahead
Confirmed in 2011–2021 at Monaco, Croatia, Albania and Algeria
Strongest: Croatia (+0.52σ) and Algeria (+0.46σ)

headline: Heatwaves come with a warmer Mediterranean
bullets: Up to +0.67σ before heatwaves in 1950–2010
Significant at 7 of 12 sites
In 2011–2021 the whole basin is 1–1.5σ warmer, which blurs the signal

headline: Remote SST adds longer lead times, up to 3 months
bullets: Selected 2 weeks to 3 months ahead
Heatwave days slightly warmer (+0.2 to +0.4σ) at 6 sites in 1950–2010
Confirmed in 2011–2021 and after detrending at Turkey (40–47 days)
Blue = 1950–2010 cooler than the 1980–2010 reference

headline: Tropical SST adds lead times of 1–3 months
bullets: Heatwave days slightly warmer (+0.1 to +0.3σ) at 7 sites in 1950–2010
Confirmed in 2011–2021 and after detrending at Turkey (66–69 days)
Blue = 1950–2010 cooler than the 1980–2010 reference

headline: Precursors are regional circulation modes, shared by neighbouring sites
bullets: KMeans clusters match varimax-rotated EOFs (r = 0.76–0.95)
4 of the 8 modes precede heatwaves in 1950–2010 and 2011–2021
Alps–Balkans ridge: Monaco, Croatia, Albania, Greece and Algeria, 3–20 days ahead
